baslik: The Physics That Makes Explosions Deadly
hook: Its not the fire that kills
aciklama:
An explosion kills in a way most people misunderstand. It is not the flames - it is a wall of pressure moving faster than sound.

#shorts #physics #science #engineering #explosion

sahneler.metin: An explosion does not kill mainly with fire.
It kills with pressure - a wall of air moving faster than sound.
In a fraction of a second, solid material turns into expanding gas.
That gas slams outward as a shockwave, crushing everything near it.
The wave can burst lungs and eardrums before the heat even arrives.
Then comes the vacuum, as air rushes back to fill the gap.
This back-and-forth is why blasts throw people in both directions.
Distance is everything - the pressure drops fast as it spreads.
Which is why survivors are often the ones who were lying flat.
